classification.difficultyReason: Translate repeated and algebraic angle labels into equations using right, straight, opposite or revolution relationships, then subtract constants and divide to find each unknown.

content.prompt: In each diagram below, angles marked with the same Greek letter are equal in size. Find the value of each, giving reasons for your answers.

spec.description: Straight line ABC with rays BD and BE; all three upper sectors labelled alpha. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Three equal adjacent angles form a straight angle at B.

spec.description: Straight line JKL, rays KM and KN, given 100-degree sector and two beta sectors. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: 100 degrees plus two equal beta angles forms a straight angle at K.

spec.description: Straight lines DVC and BVA intersect; ray VM divides angle AVC into two theta sectors. Angle DVB is 40 degrees. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Angle AVC is vertically opposite the 40-degree angle and equals two theta angles.

spec.description: Three rays OY, OX and OZ with a right-angle square between OY and OX and beta in each remaining sector. No additional straight line. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Two equal beta angles and a right angle form a revolution at O.

spec.description: Five separate rays VA, VE, VD, VC and VB with alpha in each consecutive sector; no straight-line assertion. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Five equal angles form a revolution at V.

spec.description: Straight line VWX with vertical WB and ray WA inside right angle BWX; sectors labelled 2 alpha and alpha. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent angles 2 alpha and alpha form a right angle at W.

spec.description: Straight lines EG and NM with a downward ray to P. Retains theta, 60 degrees, gamma and 3 gamma; no printed vertex label or right-angle mark is added. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Theta and 60 degrees form a straight angle; gamma plus 3 gamma plus 60 degrees also forms a straight angle.

spec.description: Straight line JKL with ray KD and labels alpha plus 50 and alpha. The source omission of the degree symbol after 50 is retained. Ordinary source blue becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: The two adjacent angle expressions form a straight angle at K; numerical angle sizes are in degrees.
